about_the_game:
★The moment you step into the vast storage facility for combat vehicles, you are drawn into an unforeseen situation. As mysterious AI-controlled enemies close in, you must find and pilot these combat vehicles in order to advance deeper inside.

In this game, you will not only use combat vehicles to face formidable foes, but at times you’ll drive carts, and at other times dangerous actions on foot will also be required. Through tense exploration and combat, you will make your way further into the depths of a strange facility.

★This shooting action-adventure combines retro 2D top-down visuals with realistic physics. With crisp, easy-to-read graphics and an atmosphere of constant tension, it delivers both exploration and combat in a uniquely engaging way.

---- STORY ----

Eldon Dallas, a wealthy magnate.

A genius engineer and the CEO of one of the world’s leading arms industries.

He has shut himself away inside a massive storage facility he owns, cutting off all contact with the outside world.

It is rumored that the facility houses an enormous number of combat vehicles.

The place, sealed by a security system, was thought to be impossible to enter from the outside.

Yet, by chance, a special cart—believed to grant authorized access—was discovered near the facility.

And your purpose is only one:

to confirm the safety of Eldon Dallas.
